$comment: Certified KIVO engines (ADR 0005 step 4). An entry is added only by a reviewed pull request after the reference 2.0 export of the hosted editor exists; keyed by (engineDigest, rulesBundleHash). Empty = nothing can be certified. Entry shape: { "engineDigest": "sha256:<64 hex>", "rulesBundleHash": "sha256:<64 hex>" (a lib/alds/bundles/bundles.json hash), "certifiedKinds": string[] (questions[].authoringKind values the reference export proved), "editorVersion": string, "registeredAt": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reference": string (the reference export and the review that admitted it) }. Read by lib/alds/guardian.ts (loadEngineAllowlist, findAllowlistEntry).
